headline: Amazon removes Alexa control of Echo speakers' AUX input
summary: Amazon has ended Alexa's ability to control Echo speakers' 3.5mm AUX input, confirming that voice commands like play or pause will stop working for devices connected via the aux line-in.

claims.statement: Amazon removed Alexa's ability to control Echo speakers through their 3.5mm AUX input.

sources.quote: Amazon kills Alexa’s ability to control Echo speakers' AUX input
Alexa can’t control the aux input on Amazon Echo speakers anymore

claims.statement: Amazon confirmed that voice commands to play or pause from the aux line-in may stop working.

sources.quote: Alexa voice commands to play or pause from line in may stop working
